directories.description: Directory rules. Strings match directory names anywhere in the tree (with native PowerShell wildcards). Strings containing '/' or '\' match paths relative to the target. Object form { name, requires } only matches when a sibling file in the parent matches one of the requires globs.

name.description: Directory name to match (no slashes; wildcards allowed)

requires.description: Glob patterns. Rule fires only when a sibling file in the parent of the matched directory matches at least one pattern.

files.description: File-name glob patterns matched anywhere in the tree.

exclude.description: Paths or names that are never deleted. Same matching grammar as directories. Checked before any rule.

forbiddenRoots.description: Extra directories that the cleaner refuses to operate on. Drive roots, the user profile and Documents are always forbidden.
